title: MemoryCaptureRequest
description: Capture raw material for one subject and produce zero or more pending candidates. Capture never writes retained records, profiles, or reflections and never triggers generation (MEM-R012). capture_scope (placement) and source_context_ids/anchors (provenance claims) are distinct and independent. Grant: capture covering the declared capture_scope. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

capture_scope.description: Required immutable admitted placement; the authorization fence for review outcomes.

source_context_ids.description: Optional provenance claims; independent of capture_scope.

anchors.description: Optional provenance claims; independent of capture_scope.

kind_hint.description: Optional advisory kind hint; classification remains advisory (§6.7).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen; unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).

content.text: Mira told Bo the gate key is hidden under the third barrel.
